definitions.gloss: synthetic leather; artificial leather; imitation leather
definitions.explanation: A material made to look and feel like real leather, typically consisting of a fabric base coated with polyurethane or polyvinyl chloride. Used in clothing, furniture, bags, and automotive interiors as a cheaper, more uniform, and animal-free alternative to natural leather.

examples.japanese: {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}のソファー。
この{鞄|かばん}は{合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}でできている。
examples.english: This bag is made of synthetic leather.

examples.japanese: {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}は{本革|ほんがわ}より{安|やす}くて{手入|てい}れも{簡単|かんたん}だ。
examples.english: Synthetic leather is cheaper than real leather and easier to care for.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}の{合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}は{品質|ひんしつ}が{高|たか}く、{見|み}た{目|め}だけでは{本革|ほんがわ}と{区別|くべつ}がつかない{場合|ばあい}もある。
examples.english: Recent synthetic leather is high in quality, and sometimes cannot be distinguished from real leather by appearance alone.

notes:
Composed of {合成|ごうせい} (synthetic) and {皮革|ひかく} (leather, hide). A formal term used especially on product labels and in commerce; spoken Japanese often uses shorter words like フェイクレザー or {人工|じんこう}レザー.

USAGE:
- Used as a material noun, typically in attributive form with の: {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}の{鞄|かばん}.
- Common on product tags and labels in retail: {素材|ざいてい}: {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}{製|せい}: made of synthetic leather
- {合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}のソファー: synthetic leather sofa
- {高品質|こうひんしつ}の{合成|ごうせい}{皮革|ひかく}: high-quality synthetic leather

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {本革|ほんがわ}: real leather / genuine leather — natural animal leather
- {人工|じんこう}レザー: artificial leather — casual / marketing term, synonymous
- フェイクレザー: faux leather — casual English loanword, common in fashion
- ビニールレザー: vinyl leather — PVC-based imitation leather, older term
